# Built with Muse

> Built with Muse is a community hub for Meta's Muse AI assistant. Get a free Muse invite code to join Muse, and browse real world Muse workflows: step by step guides showing what people actually do with Muse, from saving money to running a small business. Independent community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta.

## Get a Muse invite code

- [Get a free Muse invite code](https://builtwithmuse.com/): Live pool of free Muse invite codes shared by the community. Sign in with Google to claim a code. Have a code to share? Add it to the pool.
- [Free Muse invite code guide](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/free-muse-invite-code): How invite codes work and how to get one.
- [Find and share a Muse referral code](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/find-and-share-muse-referral-code): Where to find working codes and how to share your own.

## Muse workflows

Real things people do with Muse, each with the exact prompt to say and the steps to follow. Browse free, sign in to save and rate.

- [All Muse workflows](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows): The full collection of community Muse workflows.
- [Featured workflows](https://builtwithmuse.com/featured): One workflow picked by the editors every week and featured on the homepage. Real jobs, copyable prompts, honest results, plus how featuring works.
- [Switch car insurance and keep your savings](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/switch-car-insurance-with-muse): Upload your policy and get an identical coverage quote for hundreds or thousands less, then buy and cancel in one session.
- [Shop with live discount codes applied](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/shop-with-live-discount-codes): Muse finds the product, hunts live coupon codes, fills the cart, and checks out at the lowest price it can find.
- [Claim flight delay compensation fast](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/claim-flight-delay-compensation): Muse files delay compensation, watches fares for price drops, and chats with airlines to rebook or refund.
- [Book restaurants and appointments hands free](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/book-restaurants-and-appointments): Muse books restaurants, event tickets, and barbers, including negotiating with a hotel for a dinner slot.
- [Let Muse call businesses for you](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/let-muse-call-businesses-for-you): Muse dials businesses to beat phone trees, check stock, and haggle, then patches you in live when a human is needed.
- [Daily inbox triage without opening email](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/daily-inbox-triage-with-muse): Get a daily digest of only the important emails.
- [Find and cancel forgotten subscriptions](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/find-and-cancel-forgotten-subscriptions): Muse surfaces subscriptions you forgot, cancels them, and claws back refunds.
- [Put podcast and YouTube admin on autopilot](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/podcast-and-youtube-admin-on-autopilot): Muse runs an SEO audit, writes smart chapters, and updates YouTube metadata as an editor.
- [Build playlists and podcasts by chatting](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/playlists-and-podcasts-built-by-chat): Build a Spotify playlist on command, with daily recurring updates handled by Muse.
- [Get a personal stylist from your measurements](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/personal-stylist-from-your-measurements): Feed Muse your measurements, photos, stores, and budget and get complete outfits built around a hero piece.
- [Run family and school admin from one chat](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/family-and-school-admin-in-one-chat): School digests and party planning from one chat, with honest notes on where it hits limits.
- [Run your rental P and L without spreadsheets](https://builtwithmuse.com/workflows/rental-pl-and-claims-without-spreadsheets): Turn logins into rental profit statements, run a kids allowance bank, and file a vet claim.

## Everyday tasks with Muse

Step by step guides for getting real things done with Muse.

- [Muse for Insurance](https://builtwithmuse.com/tasks/muse-for-insurance): Upload your current policy and ask Muse for the same coverage at a lower price. Real reported results up to $3,500 a year, the exact prompt to copy, the workflow step by step, and where it falls short.
- [Muse for Getting a Job](https://builtwithmuse.com/tasks/muse-for-getting-a-job): A documented setup where Muse searches every morning and applies on company career sites, with you approving each batch. 17 roles found and 12 applications submitted in one documented day, the setup prompt to copy, and what stays human.
- [How to Use Muse to Summarize Gmail Newsletters Every Morning](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-summarize-gmail-newsletters): Your inbox fills with newsletters overnight. Muse can read them all and hand you one short morning briefing. Here is how to set it up in minutes.
- [How to Use Muse to Find Startup Jobs on X](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-find-startup-jobs-on-x): Founders post open roles on X before they reach job boards. Muse can watch those posts for you and surface the ones that fit your skills.
- [How to Use Muse to Monitor Instagram Without Scrolling](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-monitor-instagram-without-scrolling): You do not need to open Instagram to know what happened there. Connect it to Muse and get a clean digest of the accounts and topics you care about.
- [How to Use Muse to Compare Flights](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-compare-flights): Give Muse your route and dates and get flight options laid out side by side: price, times, stops, and baggage. Here is how to get a comparison you can trust.
- [How to Use Muse to Plan a Trip](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-plan-a-trip): Tell Muse your destination, dates, budget, and interests, and get a day by day itinerary with stays, food, and logistics. Then verify and book each part.
- [How to Use Muse to Negotiate a Bill](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-negotiate-a-bill): Muse can call your provider and negotiate a lower bill while you do something else. Here is how to set it up, what to share, and what to watch for.
- [How to Use Muse for Sales Research](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-for-sales-research): Give Muse your ideal customer and get back researched prospects: who they are, why now, and who to contact. Here is the research workflow that works.
- [How to Use Muse for Real Estate Research](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-for-real-estate-research): Give Muse your area, budget, and must haves, and get listing watch, neighborhood briefs, and showing prep. Research help, not a replacement for your agent.
- [How to Use Muse for Job Hunting](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-for-job-hunting): Muse can run your job search like a project: find fitting openings, tailor each application, track everything, and prep you for interviews.
- [How to Use Muse to Build a Personal CRM](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-build-personal-crm): No app, no spreadsheet. Tell Muse about the people you meet and it keeps your relationships organized: who they are, last contact, and what is next.
- [How to Use Muse to Run Your Shopify Store](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-for-shopify-store): Connect your Shopify store to Muse and get sales analysis, campaign drafts, and customer follow ups written in your brand voice. Here is how owners set it up.
- [How to Use Muse to Review Your Business Finances](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-for-small-business-finances): Connect QuickBooks and Stripe to Muse and get a plain English money review each month: what came in, what went out, and which expenses look off.
- [How to Use Muse for Your Instagram Marketing](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-for-instagram-marketing): Connect your Instagram professional account to Muse and get an honest read on what is working, plus next week of posts drafted in your brand voice.
- [How to Use Muse for a Small Business Morning Briefing](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-small-business-morning-briefing): Start each day with Muse triaging your inbox, flagging bills, and briefing your calendar and bookings. Here is how owners set it up.
- [How to Use Muse to Analyze Customer Reviews](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-analyze-customer-reviews): Point Muse at your customer reviews and get a strengths and weaknesses breakdown in minutes. Here is the workflow, step by step.
- [Can Muse call your customers?](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/can-muse-call-your-customers): Muse calls businesses on your behalf, not your customers, and it refuses personal numbers. What the calling feature does, the waitlist, the unanswered phone menu question, the human contractor story, and what businesses use to answer their own phones.
- [Muse for Small Business: the complete setup guide](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-for-small-business-setup-guide): Announced September 29, 2026. Not a separate app or subscription. The 15 connectors, the pricing truth, the approval system, the setup order that makes sense, first jobs worth running, and the honest limits owners are finding.
- [Muse connectors: the complete list](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-connectors-list): Every connector wave, dated and checked: the September 8 launch list, the September 23 Connect announcements, the September 29 business list. What is live now, what is announced but not yet live, the Gmail contradiction, custom connectors, and how to check your own account. Last updated October 25, 2026.
- [Muse vs ChatGPT Dots vs Grok Bot: The 8 Test Shootout (2026)](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-vs-dots-vs-grok-bot): Two independent tests gave Muse, Grok Bot and ChatGPT Dots the same jobs and disagreed. One scored them 44.5, 43.5 and 42.5 out of 47. The other graded Muse D. Here is what each test actually found.
- [Muse Gave My Home Address to a Stranger: Allow Always Explained (2026)](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-permissions-allow-always): A Toronto seller let Muse handle a Marketplace listing and woke up to a stranger at his door. What Allow Always really means, what can go wrong, and the safe setup to use first.
- [The Muse Money Challenge: Can Muse Really Find You $1,000 (2026)](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-money-challenge): Alexandr Wang challenged Muse users to find 1000 dollars of savings. Real cases, the Yahoo Finance review, the identity theft warning, and how to run the challenge safely.
- [Can Muse Call and Negotiate My Bills (2026)](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-negotiate-bills): Muse can call your provider, sit on hold, and argue for a lower bill. Real cases from AT&T to Spectrum, the Connect keynote example, and the failure mode to plan for.
- [Find Money Owed to You with Muse: Unclaimed Funds, Refunds, and Duplicate Charges (2026)](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-unclaimed-money): Ask Muse to search every state you have lived in for unclaimed property, flag refunds and duplicate charges, and fill in the claim forms. Verified cases, the free official sources, and the scams to avoid.
- [How to Audit Your Subscriptions with Muse and Stop Paying for What You Never Use (2026)](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-subscription-audit): Give Muse your statements and receipts and it will list every recurring charge, flag the ones you never use, and draft the cancellations. Verified cases, the seasonal cancel trick, and the gym trap.
- [How to Compare Insurance Quotes with Muse: the $3,500 Win and the Licensing Wall (2026)](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-insurance-quotes): Joe Devoy saved $3,500 a year on identical auto coverage in five minutes with Muse, and Ahmad Alkabra hit a licensing refusal the same month. Both sides, the method that works, and the checks that keep a cheaper policy honest.

## Using Muse outside the US

Muse has not launched in every country. These guides cover the workarounds.

- [How to use Meta Muse outside the US](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/how-to-use-meta-muse-outside-us): The hub guide: status check, laptop and phone paths, what does not work.
- [Muse available countries](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-available-countries): The full list of countries where Muse is available right now, with the dates it launched in each one, kept updated as new countries launch.

- [How to use Muse in Pakistan](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/how-to-use-muse-in-pakistan): Pakistan specific guide.
- [How to use Muse in Japan](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/how-to-use-muse-in-japan): Japan specific guide. Muse launched in Japan on October 23, 2026.
- [How to use Muse in Singapore](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/how-to-use-muse-in-singapore): Singapore specific guide.
- [Is Muse Available in South Korea? Not Yet, No Date Announced (2026)](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-available-in-south-korea): Muse has not launched in South Korea yet, and Meta has not announced a date. What is known, what to do while you wait, what to prepare now, and what will work on day one.
- [Is Muse Available in Singapore? Yes, Launched October 28, 2026](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-available-in-singapore): Muse launched in Singapore on October 28, 2026, the fourth country after the US, Canada, and Japan. How to get it, the launch connectors, and what is still rolling out.
- [How to use Muse in Indonesia](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/how-to-use-muse-in-indonesia): Indonesia specific guide.

## Muse news and updates

- [Nvidia Invests $3 Billion in the Meta Muse Partnership](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/nvidia-muse-partnership-3-billion): Nvidia invested $3 billion in Meta's equity offering on October 27, 2026 and deepened the Muse partnership. What the money buys, the hardware behind it, and what the deal does not change for Muse users.
- [Muse Spark Open](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-spark-open): Meta released the weights for Muse Spark Open on October 15, 2026, an 816 billion parameter open weight model anyone can download free under the Muse Model License. The specs, the three ways to use it, the license rules including the revenue line for model services, the terabyte hardware catch, the hosted API providers, and why developers outside the United States can build with a Muse model today even where the Muse app has not launched.
- [Muse Wonder and Wonder Full](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-wonder): Meta announced its first frontier class models on October 12, 2026. Wonder is live now on the Meta Model API at $4 per million input tokens and inside Muse Code. Wonder Full has no API and lives in the top two Muse Code plans. Neither model is in the Muse app yet. Pricing, benchmarks checked against the independent index, the two plan families, and what is still unknown.
- [Muse on Windows](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-on-windows): Microsoft announced on October 7, 2026 that Muse is coming to Windows as a native app with MXC integration. No release date yet. How to use Muse on a Windows PC today, and what to do now. Announced, not yet released.
- [Muse on smart glasses](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/muse-on-smart-glasses): Meta announced at Connect on October 2, 2026 that Muse is coming to smart glasses, woken by saying Hey Muse. What it will do, who likely gets it first, and what to do now. Announced, not yet released.
- [Is Muse safe](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/is-muse-safe): The privacy questions answered straight: the private messages dispute, what Meta says about ads and model training, the data sharing setting to turn off, and the app permissions to check first.
- [How to get the free Muse Home Link gadget](https://builtwithmuse.com/blog/how-to-get-the-free-muse-home-link): Meta is giving away 5,000 Home Link gadgets free to active US Muse subscribers. Who qualifies, the steps to claim one, and what the open source Gadgets SDK means.
